CustomField.description: BR-11/BR-12. Current SLA state, derived. Zero mutation - nothing writes this. Unmeasurable is deliberately distinct from Breached: an unmeasurable record is not a breached one (M-07).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(SLA_Target_DateTime__c), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Exception_Type__c))), "Excluded", "Unmeasurable" ), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(First_Touch_DateTime__c)), IF( First_Touch_DateTime__c <= SLA_Target_DateTime__c, "Met", "Breached (Late Response)" ), IF( NOW() > SLA_Target_DateTime__c, "Breached", IF( NOW() > SLA_Target_DateTime__c - 0.041666667, "At Risk", "Pending" ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current SLA state. Derived - not editable by anyone.
CustomField.label: SLA Status
